manifest.evidentiary_limit: This measures current tokenizer cost only. It neither measures comprehension nor forecasts token cost after Ainglish appears in future training data and tokenizers.
manifest.method: Under the declared tiktoken version, count len(encode(ainglish)) minus len(encode(english)) for every frozen complete pair; average within each form stratum, weight the two strata equally, and report the least-favourable maximum tokenizer mean.
